name: Area-matched protein-interface benchmark dataset
description: Dataset supporting 'When interface size misleads: an area-matched, sequence-cluster-disjoint benchmark for biological-versus-crystal interface classification.' It contains the frozen Many-2000 development descriptors and cross-fitted predictions, the locked area-matched DC panel descriptors and predictions, post hoc comparator predictions, machine-readable evaluation results, and provenance audits. No manuscript file is included.
